workItem: OPS-ROADMAP-BRANCH-EVIDENCE-01 — extend the existing /api/roadmap runtime with read-only behind=0 branch evidence bound to exact CURRENT_MAIN.
workItemDE: OPS-ROADMAP-BRANCH-EVIDENCE-01 — bestehende /api/roadmap-Runtime um read-only Branch-Evidence mit behind=0, gebunden an exakten CURRENT_MAIN, erweitern.
priorityReason: The public Control Center Roadmap needs a truthful Live mode for current branches without moving GitHub credentials or repository authority into the browser.
projectStage: PVC-02 Controlled Implementation / PVC-08 Production Operations
dependencies: Existing /api/roadmap router and authenticated GitHub read path
FE successor PR #1476 consumes this evidence only after merge
scopeBoundary: GET-only GitHub branch and compare reads; no branch/PR/workflow/deploy/provider mutation.
CURRENT_MAIN remains the sole base authority; a live branch is eligible only when behindBy=0 and aheadBy>0.
Project/label attribution is derived from canonical project branchSlug routing; unresolved branches remain explicit and non-authorizing.
No GitHub token or raw provider response is returned to the browser.
No second Roadmap task-state registry or lifecycle plane.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/roadmap/branches returns exact currentMainSha plus only ahead>0 / behind=0 branch evidence.
Branch evidence contains branch name/head SHA/ahead/behind and canonical project owner metadata when resolvable.
Diverged/behind/identical branches are not presented as Live.
Cache is bounded and stale state is explicit.
Focused tests cover eligible, diverged and unresolved-owner branches.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment; no agent self-merge.
